label: The Potion Shop on Pell Island
summary: You inherit your grandmother's dusty potion shop. The islanders need it open again by the Harvest Lantern festival.
title: The Potion Shop on Pell Island
description: Your grandmother's potion shop on Pell Island has been closed for a year. The windows are dusty, the cauldron is cold and a very large cat is living in the herb drawer. The islanders are thrilled you have come: the Harvest Lantern festival is in one season, and nobody else knows how to brew the lantern oil.

chapterOutlines.title: A Dusty Welcome
chapterOutlines.outline: Arrive on the ferry turtle and open the shop for the first time.

chapterOutlines.title: Neighbors and Recipes
chapterOutlines.outline: Meet the islanders, gather ingredients and brew your first potions.

chapterOutlines.title: The Harvest Lantern
chapterOutlines.outline: Brew the lantern oil in time for the festival.

scene.location: The ferry turtle's back, arriving at Pell Island's little harbor, on a breezy spring morning
scene.summary: The turtle yawns. On the dock, half the island has come to see the new potion-maker. Someone is holding a welcome banner upside down.

openThreads: Why did Grandmother close the shop?
Who keeps leaving herbs on the doorstep at night?

npcs.name: Bramble
npcs.description: An enormous orange cat who came with the shop and may understand every word you say. He has strong feelings about catnip.
goals: Get you to brew catnip tonic

npcs.name: Fen Holloway
npcs.description: The island's lighthouse keeper, who grows rare herbs in the lighthouse garden and talks to them.

npcs.name: Mayor Pip Tumble
npcs.description: The island's cheerful mayor, who has never once made a decision without forming a committee first.
goals: Throw the best festival in a hundred years

items.name: Grandmother's recipe book
items.description: Spidery handwriting, pressed flowers and notes like 'add moonlight, not too much'.

items.name: Copper cauldron
items.description: Dented, well loved and a little temperamental.

items.name: Watering can
items.description: For the herb garden behind the shop.
